Subject: Silverline - Inference pilot walkthrough

Hi Samantha / Thomas,

Thanks again for taking the intro call last week — appreciate the openness on where you want to explore inference for your summarization pipeline. Would love to get a short technical walkthrough scheduled to match your team's availability and make sure we demo the right pieces (end-to-end latency, KV-cache behavior, and our cost controls).

Two options that work on our side (PST):
- Tue Dec 7, 10:00–10:45am PST
- Thu Dec 9, 2:00–2:45pm PST

Proposed agenda (30–45m):
1) Quick 5m recap of goals
2) 20m live demo: ingestion -> inference -> batching & cache
3) 10m Q&A and next steps (sandbox access, pricing banding)

Attached is a one-pager that covers the runtime and a rough SOW draft to help your procurement if this moves forward. Can you confirm which slot looks best and who from your side will join? If neither works, send a couple of times and I can adjust.

Thanks,
Jonas

--

Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 08:15:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Silverline - Inference pilot walkthrough

Jonas — thanks for the follow-up and for the materials. Quick update from our side: the product leadership team just did a mid-quarter resource shuffle. We have a company offsite and a European customer rollout the week of Dec 6 which pulls our ML infra and product owners (the exact folks we need on the call) into travel and consolidation work.

Beyond travel, leadership has decided to deprioritize new inference pilots this quarter to focus on core platform stability and a set of foundational data-migration projects. In short: we need to park the pilot and demo for now.

Can we pause scheduling for December and revisit early next year? I expect us to re-open exploration around March (Q1->Q2 planning). If possible, can you share a short written recap (1 page) of the value props, a ballpark of unit cost assumptions, and any security/SOC2 pointers so procurement can archive it? That would help us pick back up later without re-running discovery.

I appreciate your flexibility — this is a roadmap-level shift not a product decision. CCing Thomas for procurement visibility.

—Sam

- Pause live walkthroughs for December (we'll mark the demo as "on hold" in HubSpot).
- I'll send a 1-page recap + ballpark cost ranges and pointer to our SOC2/security pack (attached).
- Redwood will keep the sandbox reserved (read-only access) for up to 90 days — no charge until you signal readiness.
- Tentative follow-up window: week of Mar 8, 2027. I'll create a Calendly placeholder and a HubSpot task so we don't lose the thread.

If that sounds right, I'll: 1) update the HubSpot record, 2) share the one-pager + cost sketch, and 3) ask CS to keep the sandbox available through end of February.

Thanks again — and if anything changes (leadership reprioritizes earlier), just ping me and we can slot a short 30m sync.

Best,
